title: AMMO Campaign State
description: Authoritative schema for kernel_opt_artifacts/state.json. Round-centric hierarchy: all mutable pipeline state lives under campaign.rounds[N]. The validation hook blocks non-conforming writes.

optimization_category.description: AMMO optimization-category catalog (v4.1+). Non-exhaustive DESCRIPTOR, not the eligibility gate — the gate is the principle in SKILL.md NN#8 (authored mechanism logic/structure + profiled bottleneck + measured parity-safe E2E win). Champions self-classify in Phase 0; a novel mechanism that passes the gate but fits no listed class names a new descriptor. The three legacy values (kernel_replacement, kernel_fusion, dispatch_optimization) are RETAINED so paused campaigns resume cleanly: kernel_replacement folds into custom_kernel, dispatch_optimization into execution_pipeline_restructuring. Add-only / monotonic — never remove a value. See references/optimization-categories.md.

session_id.description: Session UUID recorded at campaign start. Enables eval pipeline to extract timing and cost data.

codex_thread_id.description: Immutable Codex root thread UUID from the trusted hook payload; used for state_5.sqlite lifecycle traversal.

schema_version.description: Schema version pinning. v4.0 introduces map-based e2e_latency, per_bs_verdict siblings, kernel_speedup split, and additionalProperties locking. v4.1 introduces f_e2e framework and optimization-category taxonomy. v4.2 introduces top_f_e2e_pct/top_addressable_e2e_pct mining metrics (Stage 7 stop check), the contingent_host_spike selection mode with gate_5_2_boundary A/B arithmetic, SKIPPED gate values, and durable implementer/monitor pairing fields.

status.description: Campaign lifecycle status. Terminal values: campaign_complete, campaign_exhausted.

current_round.description: The active round number (1-indexed). campaign.rounds[current_round-1] MUST exist.

current_stage.description: Current pipeline stage. Terminal pseudo-stages eliminated: when campaign.status is terminal, current_stage stays at whatever stage was last active.

min_e2e_improvement_pct.description: PASS floor: per-BS speedup must clear 1 + max(this, noise_tolerance_pct)/100. Keep >= noise_tolerance_pct so the minimum win never sits inside the declared noise band.

debate_elimination_score_floor.description: LEGACY (superseded by EV ranking): weighted-total floor for eliminating a debate candidate. Under EV scoring the elimination floor is EV_pct < min_e2e_improvement_pct (see references/debate-scoring-rubric.md § Winner Selection Rules). Retained for backward compatibility with pre-EV campaigns.

cumulative_speedup_vs_round1.description: Deprecated (v3 compat). Final integrated E2E latency of Round 1 baseline ÷ current integrated latency. In v4.0 this is computed at read time by the backend normalizer.

round_1_baseline_latency_s.description: Deprecated (v3 compat). Anchor baseline for cumulative_speedup_vs_round1: round 1's E2E latency in seconds. In v4.0 derived from rounds[0].baseline.e2e_latency[smallest_bs].avg.

shipped_optimizations.description: List of shipped optimizations as {op_id, round, classification}. Legacy string-array form is not allowed.

agent_costs.description: Auto-populated by eval pipeline from session logs.

mining_invalidated.description: Optional. MUST be boolean true to take effect — the engine routes the next round to 2_bottleneck_mining (re-mine) instead of 3_debate ONLY when this is exactly boolean true (ammo_state.advance uses `is True`). A string or any non-true value is ignored. Set only when the diagnosis (not just the fix) was wrong; put the justification in mining_invalidated_reason.

mining_invalidated_reason.description: Optional human-readable justification for mining_invalidated=true. Companion to mining_invalidated; carries the reason text (the boolean carries the trigger).

top_component.description: Name of the top bottleneck component identified in mining (e.g., 'fused_moe', 'attention_decode'). Written by orchestrator after T2 completes by parsing the structured table in bottleneck_analysis.md.

top_f_decode_pct.description: f_decode share (% of decode wall time) of the top bottleneck component. Source: bottleneck_analysis.md structured table.

amdahl_ceiling.description: Amdahl ceiling (max E2E improvement %) for the top bottleneck assuming infinite kernel speedup. Computed as f_e2e × 100. Written by orchestrator after T2.

decode_frac.description: Fraction of total E2E spent in the decode phase, in [0, 1]. Drives the DECODE/PREFILL phase bar + 'decode frac' stat in the L2 mining tooltip. Source: bottleneck_analysis.md profile summary.

component_breakdown.description: Top-N component shares (sorted descending by pct) for the L2 mining tooltip's multi-row breakdown table. Source: bottleneck_analysis.md structured table — same rows as the markdown table, parsed into objects.

pct.description: Component share as a PERCENT in [0, 100], NOT a decimal fraction. The orchestrator must multiply f_e2e (e.g. 0.534) by 100 before writing. Picking the wrong column from bottleneck_analysis.md (e.g. f_e2e instead of decode_share %) writes a valid-but-mis-scaled value the FE will render as a near-zero bar.

top_f_e2e_pct.description: f_e2e share (% of total E2E wall time) of the top bottleneck component: f_e2e = f_decode x decode_busy x decode_share_of_e2e. Written by orchestrator after T2 by parsing the Workload Dilution table in bottleneck_analysis.md.

top_addressable_e2e_pct.description: Largest measured f_e2e x removable_fraction across non-overlapping slices, as a % of total E2E. This is the Stage 7 stop check input: the campaign stops iff this value is below campaign.config.min_e2e_improvement_pct. Written by orchestrator after T2.

bottleneck_mining.$comment: Enrichment non-null enforcement is deliberately NOT a schema allOf: an unconditional post-completion requirement rejected EVERY subsequent state write once one round lacked the fields (deadlock on legacy-round resume). The engine (ammo_state.py gate_violation) enforces non-null at the ROUND-ADVANCE write instead: advancing the current round past 2_bottleneck_mining with any of {top_bottleneck_share_pct, top_component, top_f_decode_pct, amdahl_ceiling, decode_frac, component_breakdown} still null is blocked; all other writes pass.

proposal_count.description: Total number of proposal markdown files emitted in rounds/{N}/debate/proposals/. Written by orchestrator after T7 (debate winner selection).

rationale_count.description: Total number of debate rationale files (arguments + critiques + rebuttals) emitted across the debate phase. Written by orchestrator after T7.

scoreboard.description: Final debate scoreboard keyed by op_id with score breakdown per candidate. Free-form object — schema is intentionally loose because the rubric evolves. Written by orchestrator after T7.

champions_count.description: Number of champion agents that participated in this debate round (typically 2-4). Written by orchestrator after T7.

winners.description: Mirror of selected_winners as a top-level field for FE convenience. Written by orchestrator after T7. May duplicate selected_winners; FE should prefer this field for L2 rendering.

result.description: Short human-readable summary of the debate outcome (e.g., '2 winners selected: OP-001 (lossless), OP-002 (quant)'). Written by orchestrator after T7.

selected_candidates.description: Authoritative cross-agent contract (array — debate typically selects 2-4 winners). Moderator writes this; ammo-impl-champion spawned per op_id reads the entry whose op_id matches its assigned track, BEFORE any summary.md. summary.md is a lead-authored human view of this array; on disagreement state.json wins. op_id values here must match entries in selected_winners above.

name.description: Short display name minted with the op_id: 2-4 plain words describing the mechanism (e.g. 'fused rmsnorm quant'). The op_id stays the key; the name is for prose and summaries. Optional for pre-4.2 records.

proposal_file.description: Path relative to artifact_dir of the winning proposal file, e.g. rounds/{N}/debate/proposals/{champion_id}_proposal.md. Written by the lead at T7.

evidence_scope.description: Optional. Where the projected magnitude was measured (references/debate-rules.md § Evidence-Scope Ladder). Out of required[] for back-compat: pre-4.2 selected_candidates omit it. A newly selected candidate with evidence_scope=='proxy' is a gate_violation.

category.description: Optional in v4.0; required for v4.1+ campaigns. Champion's self-declared optimization category — drives per-category projection formula and Stage 4/5 validation routing.

projected_e2e_improvement_pct.description: Champion's projected E2E improvement pct using the per-category projection formula (see references/optimization-categories.md). Stage 5 reads this to compute projected-vs-realized ratio. v4.1+.

selection_mode.description: How the candidate won its slot. 'ordinary' = admissible projected_e2e_improvement_pct >= floor, ranked by EV. 'contingent_host_spike' = host-only mechanism selected on a measured host-slice ceiling (host_slice_ceiling_pct) with no admissible magnitude yet; at most one per round; EV/projection fields remain zero and its first Gate 5.2 run is the production-boundary spike.

host_slice_ceiling_pct.description: contingent_host_spike only: the measured production host-slice ceiling (% of E2E) that justified selection. A ceiling, never a projection — supplies no EV.

tracks.description: Per-track state keyed by op_id. Updated incrementally as each gate result appears.

gate_5_1a_metrics.description: Numeric metrics from Gate 5.1a (kernel correctness). Written by orchestrator after gate 5.1a passes by reading rounds/{N}/tracks/{op_id}/validator_tests/gate_5_1a_results.json. Replaces the deprecated .metrics.json sidecar.

max_abs_err.description: Maximum absolute error observed across all tested shapes

gate_5_2_metrics.description: Numeric metrics from Gate 5.2 (kernel speedup benchmark). Written by orchestrator after gate 5.2 passes by reading rounds/{N}/tracks/{op_id}/validator_tests/gate_5_2_results.json. Replaces the deprecated .metrics.json sidecar.

gate_5_1a_skip_reason.description: Populated when gate_5_1a is SKIPPED: why the kernel-level correctness gate does not apply (e.g. host-only mechanism with no kernel boundary).

gate_5_2_skip_reason.description: Populated when gate_5_2 is SKIPPED: why the mechanism-impact gate does not apply.

branch.description: Git branch name of the track worktree.

worktree_path.description: Absolute path of the track's isolated worktree.

evidence_path.description: Path (relative to artifact_dir) of the track's evidence.json.

kill_criteria_results.description: T8d kill-criteria evaluation results keyed by criterion name.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the track reached terminal status.

implementer_agent.description: Durable pairing evidence: name of the implementer agent that owns this track.

implementer_rollout_id.description: Durable pairing evidence: rollout/thread id of the implementer agent.

monitor_agent.description: Durable pairing evidence: name of the paired transcript monitor.

monitor_evidence_path.description: Path of the monitor's observation log for this track.

monitor_offsets_path.description: Path of the monitor's incremental transcript-offset state file.

monitor_summary_path.description: Path of the monitor's terminal DA-MONITOR SUMMARY artifact.

gate_5_2_boundary.description: contingent_host_spike tracks: the production-boundary A/B arithmetic recorded by the first Gate 5.2 run. e2e_equivalent_improvement_pct = 100 x (baseline_duration_us - optimized_duration_us) x occurrence_count / baseline_e2e_us; compared against campaign_floor_pct (= campaign.config.min_e2e_improvement_pct).

clock.description: Boundary-appropriate clock used (host monotonic / NVTX+Nsys for CPU intervals; CUDA events for GPU intervals).

audit.description: Adversarial auditor verdicts per gate. Presence of the key (even empty {}) activates the audit gate in hooks; legacy campaigns without this key bypass enforcement.

started_at.description: Stamped mechanically by the auditor-spawn hook (claude: ammo-audit-start-stamp.sh; codex: post_tool_use_guard.py) when the ammo-auditor is dispatched for this gate. The lead never writes it by hand. For schema_version 4.2 and later, a gate that carries passed_at without started_at fails state validation; backfill it with ammo_state.py audit-started.

cycle.description: Audit cycle number taken from the auditor dispatch prompt. A re-audit of the same gate increments it.

stage_2.description: Stage 2 (bottleneck mining) audit gate. Fires after mining completes (schema v4.1+ only). Four-phase audit checks 9 mining-specific invariants (dilution table, f_e2e budget, etc.).

stage_67.description: Consolidated S6+S7 audit gate. Fires after SHIP + env promotion + golden-refs capture, or after EXHAUSTED status set. Four-phase audit (inventory, reconstruction, checklist, reconciliation). Checks 22 stage-specific invariants across two delegate clusters (Cluster 1: 13 integration items, Cluster 2: 9 post-SHIP items).

auto_pass.description: DEPRECATED — never set on new campaigns; legacy campaigns may have it but new rounds do not.

exhausted_technologies.description: Structured exhaustion entries appended when a round EXHAUSTED. Champions filter by applies_to_component and applies_to_shape_bucket. Replaces free-form exhaustion_note prose — no free-form reason-slot.

technology_class.description: e.g., triton_fused_moe, cutlass_gemm_hopper, cutedsl_persistent, cuda_cpp_wgmma, library_flashinfer. Closed enum — the PR #1b implementation scans corpus for values and proposes the final set.

applies_to_component.description: Null means applies to all components. Otherwise names a specific component class (e.g., fused_moe, attention, rmsnorm).

applies_to_shape_bucket.description: Null means applies to all shape buckets. Otherwise names a bucket (e.g., bs_le_8, bs_ge_32).

evidence_refs.description: file:line or artifact path citations. NOT prose — points at primary evidence.

auditor_escalation.description: Set when the audit fix loop exhausts 3 cycles. scope is either the array of quarantined track op_ids (track-scoped: campaign continues on unaffected work) or the literal string 'campaign' (campaign-scoped: status goes to paused).
